name: openwhale-pendle-workspace
description: Workspace for the OpenWhale Pendle packages: the venue plugin and the strategy package

scripts.install:all: pnpm -C openwhale-pendle install && pnpm -C openwhale-pendle-strategy install
scripts.build: pnpm -C openwhale-pendle build && pnpm -C openwhale-pendle-strategy build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -C openwhale-pendle typecheck && pnpm -C openwhale-pendle-strategy typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm -C openwhale-pendle test && pnpm -C openwhale-pendle-strategy test
